Claude: detector cannot resolve the page's alpha-composited dark surfaces (backdrop-filter glass over #05060f canvas) and falls back to an assumed white/gray background, producing false low-contrast readings. Verified in a real Chrome render at desktop and mobile widths: body text computes ~8.4:1 and muted text ~5.76:1 against the true #05060f canvas (hand-computed WCAG relative luminance). This project's own config.json already documents this detector limitation for other rules (clamp()-related false positives) from a prior session.
